edits.before: Late Trist jumps the resets: E the carry, R the peel, and jump out — or in — on every takedown.
edits.after: At 2+ items his W-Bio-Arcane Barrage range and DPS out-scale you — bank leads into towers before that point, not a duel.

edits.before: - Kog'Maw Bio-Arcane Barrage: matchup-defining — The range + shred window IS the champion — disengage for its eight seconds, fight the gaps. It governs your forward steps. - W Rocket Jump (reset) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Kog'Maw's W-Bio-Arcane Barrage is down 17s — the range + shred window IS the champion; disengage for those 17 seconds, fight the gaps. It governs your forward steps. - W Rocket Jump (reset) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: His E-Void Ooze (12s cd) is the only real punish at range — bait it, then commit the bomb string while it's down instead of walking through the slow trail.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: Buster Shot (100s cd) knocks him out of his own cast or a support's peel — holding it purely as an execute wastes its best use in this matchup.

edits.before: You are the reset carry: jump in on the pick, R the peel, and jump out on the takedown — or don't, and take the tower instead.
edits.after: Kog'Maw out-scales you at 2 items — bank tempo into towers before then. His death-explosion is true damage; don't linger for the kill.
